title: Black Bob Thunderbird figurine
subtitle: Chibi figurine of the costume mascot · 80 mm tall on a display base · red, white, black · millimetres

meshes.label: White (beak, face, chest burst, zigzags, legs, feet, BB)

scale_note: 80 mm tall is a first guess for a 'little' figurine. Type a different height in the real-size box to preview it; HEIGHT_MM in build.py sets it.
notes: v4 (you said v3's beak was too blocky, and pointed out how big the costume's beak is). The beak is rebuilt as one smooth lofted form: rounded cross-sections that taper from nearly the full width of the head down to a deep downward hook, with the mouth open and red showing inside. It's about a third longer and wider than v3, and the tip reaches about 28 mm in front of the face (design scale). The edges are soft, but the top still has a clear shape. The wings, slim body and small feet are as in v3. Check: is the size right next to the costume? Should the hook be deeper? Should the mouth be more or less open?
